overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for endgame snapshots and optimizing Monte Carlo convergence logic. This batch closes the last gaps in long-term stability and memory efficiency for 5,500+ tick simulations.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
tasks.architectural_spec: Use std::array for fixed-size buffers. Implement a static compression function using bitwise packing for 16-bit integer states. No dynamic allocation. Ensure deterministic output order via index-based iteration.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Compression ratio > 4:1 for standard state vectors. Zero heap allocations during compression. Deterministic output verified across 100 runs.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster save/load times and reduced memory footprint for long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence Check
tasks.architectural_spec: Replace iterative convergence checks with a closed-form variance estimator. Use constexpr for tolerance thresholds. Minimize branch mispredictions by unrolling the final 4 iterations.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Convergence detected within 1% error margin. Execution time reduced by 30% compared to BATCH-67 baseline. No deadlocks.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Smoother simulation ticks and faster resolution of stochastic events.
